==================
patterns: wildcard literals and bindings
==================

fn main(n: int, text: str) {
    match n {
        _ => print("wild"),
        0 => print("zero"),
        -1 => print("minus one"),
        value => print("{value}"),
    }
    match text {
        "" => print("empty"),
        "x" => print("x"),
        other => print(other),
    }
}

==================
patterns: variant payloads and struct patterns
==================

struct Point { x: int, y: int }
enum Shape { Circle(float), Rect(Point), Empty }

fn area(shape: Shape) -> float {
    match shape {
        Shape.Circle(radius) => 3.14 * radius * radius,
        Rect(Point { x, y, .. }) => float(x * y),
        Empty => 0.0,
    }
}

==================
patterns: tuples and or-patterns
==================

fn main(pair: (int, int), n: int) {
    match pair {
        (0, 0) => print("origin"),
        (x, 0) | (0, x) => print("{x}"),
        (x, y) => print("{x + y}"),
    }
    let first | second = n
}

==================
patterns: struct pattern rest last
==================

struct P { x: int, y: int }

fn main(p: P) {
    match p {
        P { x, .. } => print("{x}"),
        P { .. } => print("p"),
    }
}
